candidate.answerReason: Dave travels 108000 cm. Jack travels 6000 cm per minute, so the same route takes him 108000/6000=18 minutes.

methods.label: Find the distance and Jack's speed
methods.explanation:
Steps per minute alone do not give walking speed; we must also account for the length of each step. Dave travels
\[
90\cdot75=6750\text{ cm per minute}.
\]
His \(16\)-minute journey therefore covers \(6750\cdot16=108000\) cm.

Jack travels \(100\cdot60=6000\) cm per minute. Because he follows the same route, his distance is also \(108000\) cm. Dividing this distance by his speed gives
\[
\frac{108000}{6000}=\boxed{18\text{ minutes}},
\]
which is choice C.
methods.levelReason: This is an arithmetic distance-rate-time solution with consistent units.

The inverse relationship between multiplication and division supplies the supporting knowledge.
